Predict RM 6 7DADM from an RM 8.5 temperature value

Source: R/lm_rm6_7dadm.R
rm_6_predict.Rd

Convenience wrapper around lm_rm6_7dadm that accepts a plain numeric temperature (or vector of temperatures) at RM 8.5 and returns the predicted 7DADM at RM 6.

Usage

rm_6_predict(temp_8_5, months = 5:9)

Arguments

temp_8_5

Numeric vector. Observed or forecast 7DADM temperature at RM 8.5 in degrees C.

months

Integer vector of calendar months used to train the underlying linear model. Defaults to May–September (5:9).

Value

A numeric vector of predicted RM 6 7DADM temperatures (°C), the same length as temp_8_5.

Examples

rm_6_predict(6)          # single value
#> [1] 5.899946
rm_6_predict(c(15, 18, 20, 22))  # vector
#> [1] 15.04509 18.09347 20.12573 22.15798
